The commit history is very long. The bug was reported around March 2023. Let me look at the commits around that time. The relevant fix would be around March 2023. Let me look at the commit `748f19f` "Fix type object validation for types with no members/labels" from Jul 11, 2023 - that's after the bug report. But the bug was reported in March 2023. Let me look at commits between March and July 2023.

Let me look at the commit history around March 2023 specifically. Let me check the git log in the local repo for the fix. Actually, the local repo is the vulnerable version. Let me look at the fix commit for this specific OSS-Fuzz issue. Let me search for the fix in the commit history around March 2023.

as defined in section 7.5.2 of the DDS XTypes specification. The API

languages\).

binding, not the Dynamic Data part \(which may be added later\). The
type introspection part is also left out in this initial version.

Dynamic Type API

This introduces the implementation of the Dynamic Language binding
as defined in section 7.5.2 of the DDS XTypes specification. The API
in this implementation is roughly following the API as described in
the specification, but different choices where made at some points
(also because the approach in the spec is aimed at object oriented
languages).

This commit contains the Dynamic Type part of the dynamic language
binding, not the Dynamic Data part (which may be added later). The
type introspection part is also left out in this initial version.

Signed-off-by: Dennis Potman <dennis@zettascale.tech>

Add recursive checking in ddsi_type_resolved

In case ddsi_type_resolved_locked is called to check the resolved state
including dependent types (kind is DDSI_TYPE_INCLUDE_DEPS), the
check should be done recursively for all dependencies of the type
that is passed.

value.value:
Dynamic Type API

This introduces the implementation of the Dynamic Language binding
as defined in section 7.5.2 of the DDS XTypes specification. The API
in this implementation is roughly following the API as described in
the specification, but different choices where made at some points
(also because the approach in the spec is aimed at object oriented
languages).

This commit contains the Dynamic Type part of the dynamic language
binding, not the Dynamic Data part (which may be added later). The
type introspection part is also left out in this initial version.

Signed-off-by: Dennis Potman <dennis@zettascale.tech>
